summary: Backend-only E2E test of the OpenAI(gpt-4.1-mini) -> Gemini(gemini-3.5-flash) provider swap, using the real user-provided GEMINI_API_KEY (no mocks). Created /app/backend/tests/test_gemini_provider_switch.py with a fresh TEST_ user covering register->profile->recommendations generate/poll->career detail (fresh+cached)->custom roadmap (elektryk) generate/poll->task resources->daily-plan settings/generate. Auth with Gemini WORKS (no 401/403 anywhere in backend logs) and the regex-based JSON extraction in ask_llm() is COMPATIBLE with Gemini's streamed output -- recommendations generated correctly with valid JSON (Polish summary/now/future lists with title+summary fields), and zero 'No JSON in LLM response' ValueErrors were found in logs across the whole session. HOWEVER, the custom-roadmap generation call (and all subsequent AI calls in the same session) failed with a REAL litellm.RateLimitError 429 from Google: 'Quota exceeded for metric: generativelanguage.googleapis.com/generate_content_free_tier_requests, limit: 20... Generate content requests per day limit exceeded on Free Tier... retry in ~6.4h'. This is a genuine infra/provisioning issue with the supplied GEMINI_API_KEY (Google AI Studio Free Tier, 20 requests/day), not a code bug -- the single E2E flow in this review request alone needs >20 LLM calls (profile validation, recommendations, career detail, profession validation, roadmap, task resources x N, daily-plan items) so the key will exhaust before a single real user finishes onboarding. This is CRITICAL and blocks reliable end-to-end verification of steps 4-7 (custom roadmap, task resources, daily plan, study plan) in this session; they could not be exercised once quota hit. Could not retest further since quota resets in ~6.4h (Google-side, not fixable by restarting services).

critical.endpoint: ask_llm() / all AI endpoints (roadmap/custom, roadmap/tasks/{id}/resources, roadmap/daily-plan, roadmap/study-plan)
critical.issue: GEMINI_API_KEY provided is on Google AI Studio's Free Tier with a hard limit of 20 generate_content requests/day. The quota was exhausted mid-test (after only register+profile+recommendations+1 roadmap attempt+1 profession-validation call), causing litellm.RateLimitError 429 (RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) on every subsequent AI call for the rest of the day (~6.4h cooldown reported by Google). Exact error: "litellm.RateLimitError: vertex_ai_betaException - ... Quota exceeded for metric: generativelanguage.googleapis.com/generate_content_free_tier_requests, limit: 20, model: gemini-3.6-flash ... Please retry in 6h26m7s". This propagates as a user-visible status:"error" on /api/roadmap, and a 400 on /api/roadmap/daily-plan/settings (since the roadmap never became ready). NOT a code bug -- rollback/key-upgrade decision needed before this provider swap can be considered production-ready.

Generation ended in status:"error" with the 429 message above; milestones list stayed empty. Could not verify milestones/tasks JSON shape with a successful Gemini call in this session due to quota exhaustion.
400 'Najpierw wybierz ścieżkę i poczekaj, aż droga będzie gotowa.' -- cascading failure because the roadmap above never reached ready status. Not independently verifiable until quota resets.

minor.issue: The 429 quota-violation message references 'model: gemini-3.6-flash' even though server.py configures ANALYSIS_MODEL/FAST_MODEL as 'gemini-3.5-flash' and litellm logs confirm it requested 'gemini-3.5-flash'. Likely just Google's internal quota-bucket/version-alias naming and not an app bug, but worth a sanity check that 'gemini-3.5-flash' is actually the intended/valid model id (could also silently map to a different model version server-side).

action_items: CRITICAL: Replace/upgrade the GEMINI_API_KEY to a paid-tier (billing-enabled) Google AI Studio / Vertex key -- the current key is Free Tier limited to 20 generate_content requests/day, which is far below what even a single user's onboarding flow consumes (profile validation + recommendations + career detail + profession validation + roadmap + N task resources + daily plan items can easily be 10-30+ calls), let alone multiple concurrent testers/users.

Once a higher-quota key is available, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_gemini_provider_switch.py (use `pytest backend/tests/test_gemini_provider_switch.py -n 0` per pytest.ini's note, since this suite has sequential cross-test dependencies that break under the default -n 2 --dist loadscope parallel config) to confirm steps 4-7 (custom roadmap, task resources, daily plan, study plan) work end-to-end with Gemini.

Confirmed working with Gemini (no action needed): auth to Gemini (no 401/403 anywhere in logs), and the regex-based JSON extraction in ask_llm() successfully parsed Gemini's response for /api/recommendations/generate (valid Polish JSON with summary + now/future lists) -- no markdown-fence-wrapping or JSON-parsing issues observed before quota hit.

Low priority: double check that 'gemini-3.5-flash' is the exact correct/current Gemini model id intended (Google's quota error referenced 'gemini-3.6-flash' in the bucket label, which may just be internal aliasing, but worth a quick sanity check).
critical_code_review_comments: ask_llm() (server.py ~line 223-234) has no retry/backoff or user-facing distinction between a transient rate-limit (429) and a genuine malformed-response error -- both end up as a generic status:"error" with the raw exception string surfaced. Given Gemini Free Tier's low daily quota, consider adding a specific, friendlier Polish error message for 429/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED so users don't see a raw litellm/vertex traceback-style string if this ever leaks to the frontend.

validate_profession() fails open on any ask_llm exception (line 269-271), so when quota is exhausted it silently returns valid=True instead of surfacing the error -- the custom-path submission then proceeds and lets the subsequent roadmap generation fail instead, which is a reasonable fallback but means users could submit a flagged profession unknowingly whenever quota/API issues occur.

success_rate.backend: ~50% (2/6 new test functions fully passed: profile_submit, recommendations generate+poll; career_detail call itself succeeded with valid Polish JSON+caching though my first test-schema assumption was wrong and was fixed; custom_roadmap/task_resources/daily_plan all blocked by real Gemini 429 quota exhaustion, not a code defect)

seed_data_creation: One fresh TEST_gemini_<uuid> user created via the pytest suite with profile answers + 1 recommendations generation + 1 failed custom-roadmap attempt for 'elektryk'. Test data only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GEMINI_API_KEY free-tier quota (20 req/day) was EXHAUSTED during this session around 2026-11-01 00:33 UTC; Google reported a ~6.4h cooldown (so roughly until 2026-11-01 ~07:00 UTC). Any further real Gemini testing before that will immediately 429. Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_gemini_provider_switch.py with `-n 0` (sequential) once quota resets or a higher-tier key is provisioned -- it already covers the full flow (register->profile->recommendations->career detail (incl. caching)->custom roadmap->task resources (incl. caching)->daily plan) and just needs the key issue resolved to pass end-to-end. No JSON-parsing-format issues were observed with Gemini's output for the one successful call (recommendations), which is the main regex-extraction risk mentioned in the request -- that part looks safe.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: the newly provisioned GEMINI_API_KEY is a Google AI Studio Free Tier key, hard-capped at 20 generate_content requests/day (shared across all models/users of this key, enforced server-side by Google, not by the app). During this single test run, the app's standard calls before even reaching the roadmap step (profile-related validation + recommendations generation + profession validation for the custom path) consumed enough of the quota that the roadmap generation call hit RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED mid-stream, surfaced by litellm as RateLimitError -> MidStreamFallbackError -> ChatError('Error during streaming: ...') -> caught generically in run_roadmap, stored as status:"error" on the roadmap doc. This is not caused by the code change itself (the provider/model swap code works correctly and Gemini's JSON output parses fine with the existing regex) -- it is purely an API-key tier/quota provisioning problem that will reproduce for ANY user flow until a paid-tier key is used or the daily quota resets.
